_comment: Hand-labeled ground truth for the roadmap baseline clip. Copy this file to pomona_baseline.json and fill in the ball array. Target 50-100 labeled frames concentrated around: serves, rallies, net play, orange disconnects, YOLO misses, wrong-ball grabs, carry overuse, bounce/contact moments, adjacent-court interference, parked-ball confusion. Sparse labels across the whole video are LESS valuable than dense labels around known failure moments.

ball._example: delete this row when you start labeling

events._example: delete this row when you start labeling

ignore_ranges._example: frame ranges to skip during validation (e.g. pre-roll, replays)
